test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'XCMY' is coded as ‘AHPD’ and 'PGVK' is coded as ‘SLYP’. How will 'JOCH' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6246ffd63f0ad1e721245b6c97c17833d38fd38d256c70a4cd174c285de8ed6c.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'XCMY' is coded as ‘AHPD’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e274e501b97aab3f9a0edda83a5f020eb32aa37b1fef023d0e20d651127c6144.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4ba2210216060e2117d551bb9dfbfae1615ad6dcce60ae5683677682f0d5653.png] 

And,

'PGVK' is coded as ‘SLYP’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/936eb89284ba6851aced4855b9fea1c0a40040902fd6deabc9fd78ca36435615.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61669134932447ea2913c54fd8030d52d1b1656cf3b404a91fe451d1f4496871.png] 

Similarly,

'JOCH' is coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77ea6e3028cbf5e80e2aa3fab6d27d36b6027779ff58e0c9bf4a56e6d835f26f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14c091d119f895ae83f984c4c6b316300bf9a7bc1bfee2c8663e184ed5da88a3.png] 

Thus, 'JOCH' is coded as **'MTFM'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
